name: Skychaser the Elder
summary: Elder Skychaser is an ancestral spirit who manifests during the Lunar Festival atop the Sentinel Tower in Westfall. Honoring her allows travelers across the dust-swept plains to pay homage to the wisdom of ages past. In return, the elder acknowledges the burning vigor of the living and grants her blessing.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Dust
sections.body: Amid the troubled scrublands of Westfall, Sentinel Hill stands as the lone fortified redoubt against Defias raiders and roving scavengers. During the Lunar Festival, an ancestral spirit named Elder Skychaser takes her place on the open platform atop the Sentinel Tower. High above the dust and wind, she keeps a patient vigil over the weary soldiers and beleaguered settlers below, welcoming anyone who makes the climb to show respect.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestors
sections.body: The Lunar Festival marks a sacred season observed across Azeroth, celebrating wisdom, heritage, and the deeds of ancient spirits who walked the earth before the present struggles. When approached, Elder Skychaser recognizes the vital spark within the traveler, accepting their homage and bestowing a token of her favor as a gift of kinship between the living and the honored dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Skychaser?
faq.answer: Elder Skychaser is located at the very top of Sentinel Tower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Climb the spiral stairs within the tower out onto the upper lookout ramparts.

faq.q: Why is Elder Skychaser standing on top of Sentinel Tower?
aliases: why is he in sentinel tower
faq.answer: Ancestral spirits choose prominent and symbolic locations across Azeroth during the Lunar Festival. The heights of Sentinel Tower provide a watchful vantage over the Westfall basin, allowing the elder to witness travelers braving the frontier.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Seeking out Elder Skychaser is part of honoring ancestral elders during the Lunar Festival. Showing respect grants a Coin of Ancestry and a blessing celebrating the living spirit of the adventurer.

faq.q: Can Horde players honor Elder Skychaser?
faq.answer: Elder Skychaser herself is a peaceful spirit who welcomes all pilgrims. However, Sentinel Hill is a heavily defended Alliance outpost, making reaching her perilous for Horde adventurers.

faq.q: Does Elder Skychaser participate in the defense of Sentinel Hill?
aliases: is skychaser part of the people's militia
faq.answer: No. The elders who visit during the Lunar Festival are spiritual manifestations focused solely on tradition and ancient remembrance. Elder Skychaser takes no part in the People's Militia's skirmishes against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What does Skychaser say when you greet her?
faq.answer: Upon greeting her, Elder Skychaser remarks that your spirit burns brightly with life, graciously accepts the homage you bring, and offers an ancestral token in return.

angles.text: Elder Skychaser is conveniently stationed within the heart of the People's Militia base at Sentinel Hill, making her an easy elder to honor while questing through Westfall.
Reaching Elder Skychaser requires stealth, speed, or brute force, as Sentinel Hill is filled with hostile Alliance guards and militia scouts.
Druids hold the Lunar Festival sacred, recognizing ancestral manifestations like Skychaser as an enduring link to ancient traditions and deep natural reverence.
